# verify pairwise v-projection model against demo2 and demo1

def fill_from_segments(segs,n=16):
 g=np.full((n,n),8,int)
 for s,rlo,rhi,col in segs:
  for r in range(rlo,rhi+1):
   c=s-r
   if 0<=c<n:g[r,c]=col
 for i,(s1,a1,b1,col1) in enumerate(segs):
  v1lo,v1hi=2*a1-s1,2*b1-s1
  for s2,a2,b2,col2 in segs[i+1:]:
   if s1==s2:continue
   vlo=max(v1lo,2*a2-s2); vhi=min(v1hi,2*b2-s2)
   if vlo>vhi:continue
   slo,shi=sorted((s1,s2))
   for r in range(n):
    for c in range(n):
     s=r+c;v=r-c
     if slo<s<shi and vlo<=v<=vhi and g[r,c]==8:g[r,c]=2
 return g
# demo2 segments
segs2=[(8,4,5,5),(13,4,9,5),(18,5,13,5),(22,7,15,5)]
g2=fill_from_segments(segs2)
print('demo2 filled',sum((g2==2).flat))
